POLICE BLOTTER — Chris Orlando Torres was booked into the Webb County Jail on Tuesday evening, October 20, 2026, on a misdemeanor family-violence charge, according to Webb County booking records.

Chris Orlando Torres — arrested by the Laredo Police Department on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, at 8:48 p.m. Charged with assault causing bodily injury — family member (Class A misdemeanor). Bond had not been set as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A Class A misdemeanor in Texas is punishable by up to one year in county jail and a fine of up to $4,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Chris Orlando Torres is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal.

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
